# asPdfA4

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Enables PDF/A-4 baseline archival mode. Automatically sets version to PDF 2.0. This does not enable PDF/A-4f attachments, PDF/A-4e engineering features, or PDF/UA-2.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
asPdfA4(settings: DocumentSettings): DocumentSettings
```
